The following applications for approval of construction or modification of an air pollution source have been received by ORCAA. A formal public comment period will be provided if requested by any person, government agency, group, or applicant.

Description:

The applicant requests preapproval to modify Order of Approval 21NOC1533 Condition 1 to increase the storage limit of monochlorobenzene (MCB) in ISO containers and the permitted MCB throughput from 10,000 to 40,000 gallons per year.
